1.resumo: Spreads burns with his weapon and abilities, chases the target down with Flame Dash and closes the fight with the area stun of his ultimate.

builds.descricao: Duration and ability damage. Napalm and Afterburn become the main source of damage and the ultimate stuns for longer.
Fire rate to stack Afterburn fast. Plays like a shooter who melts the target while chasing.

2.resumo: A lightning ball to farm and poke, Static Charge to stun groups and Storm Cloud to dominate area fights.

builds.descricao: Spirit power and ability range. Storm Cloud becomes the main threat in team fights.
Weapon items with Power Surge: every shot ricochets to nearby enemies. Great for pushing lanes.

3.resumo: Flies over the battlefield and executes wounded targets from long range with Assassinate.

builds.descricao: Damage per shot and headshots. Stays airborne with Flight and punishes anyone who exposes themselves.
Strong Crow Familiar and Stake: bleed based on current health and control with the stake.

4.resumo: Spends her own health to deal damage and recovers it all by draining the enemy. Soul Exchange swaps health with the target and turns lost fights around.

builds.descricao: Spirit power so Essence Bomb and Malice blow the target up.
Health, resistances and spirit lifesteal. Stays in the fight with Life Drain and trades health at the right moment.

6.resumo: Dives into the enemy team with Shoulder Charge and Seismic Impact, soaks damage and heals with Siphon Life.

builds.descricao: Health, resistances and regeneration. Starts fights and absorbs the enemy team's focus.
Melee items and Heavy Melee. Combines Shoulder Charge into a wall with heavy punches.

7.resumo: Generates cards by shooting, isolates targets with Telekinesis and teleports in or out of the fight with Project Mind.

builds.descricao: Fire rate and ammo. Full Auto melts isolated targets.
Spirit power for Card Trick and Telekinesis: ranged damage and strong control.

8.resumo: Builds turrets, heals allies with Medicinal Specter and splits the enemy team with Spectral Wall.

builds.descricao: Items that boost summons and duration. Holds lanes and objectives on her own.
Healing, cooldowns and utility. Controls the terrain of the fight and keeps the team alive.

10.resumo: Stops time with Kinetic Carbine and Time Wall and swaps places with the enemy to throw them into the middle of her team.

builds.descricao: Weapon damage scales Kinetic Carbine. A precise shot that freezes the target.
Cooldowns and duration for Pulse Grenade and Time Wall. Sets up plays for the team.

11.resumo: Heals the team with Rejuvenating Aurora and turns fights around with Singularity, which pulls in and stuns everyone nearby.

builds.descricao: Healing, resistances and cooldowns. Keeps the team alive and waits for the perfect Singularity.
Spirit damage and duration on Singularity, with Quantum Entanglement to dive in by surprise.

12.resumo: Glides across the map on Ice Path, heals allies with Frost Grenade and protects the team with the Frozen Shelter dome.

builds.descricao: Healing and cooldowns. Plays for the team with healing grenades and the dome at the right time.
Spirit power on Arctic Beam and Frost Grenade: heavy damage and slow.

13.resumo: Vanishes with Smoke Bomb, puts the target to sleep with Sleep Dagger and pours out bullets with Fixation and Bullet Dance.

builds.descricao: Fire rate and on-hit effects. In the ultimate, she moves while shooting every enemy in front of her.
Lifesteal per bullet and resistances to survive long duels.

14.resumo: Launches enemies into the air with Powder Keg, lands headshots with Crackshot and pulls targets in with Spirit Lasso.

builds.descricao: Headshot damage and precision. Rewards good aim.
Strong Powder Keg and Bounce Pad: area damage and constant mobility.

15.resumo: Pulls the target in with Grapple Arm, blows them up with Sticky Bomb and Exploding Uppercut, and sweeps the area with Hyper Beam.

builds.descricao: Spirit power: Sticky Bomb grows with every kill and becomes a deadly combo.
Health and resistances to channel the laser in the middle of the fight.

16.resumo: Possesses the cat Ava to move hidden from the minimap, leaps with Leaping Slash and escapes with Return to Shadows.

builds.descricao: Gloom Bombs and Return to Shadows with lots of spirit power: dive in, explode, vanish.
Melee items for Leaping Slash. Chases and finishes.

17.resumo: A long-range archer with Charged Shot, traps and a guided owl that stuns from anywhere.

builds.descricao: Weapon damage on the charged shot. Pierces enemies from afar.
Spirit power for Guided Owl and Spirit Snare: damage and stuns across the map.

18.resumo: Advances underground with Burrow, pops up in the middle of the enemy and holds the target in place with Combo.

builds.descricao: Health and resistances. Scorn heals and Combo pins the enemy carry.
Spirit damage on Burrow and Sand Blast for ambushes.

19.resumo: Stacks bleed with knives, delays incoming damage with Bloodletting and executes targets with Killing Blow.

builds.descricao: Weapon and melee damage to reach the execution threshold quickly.
Health and resistances to make the most of Bloodletting's delayed damage.

20.resumo: Links up with an ally through Kudzu Connection, shares heals and bonuses, and carries allies through the air with Air Drop.

builds.descricao: Healing and utility. Empowers the team's carry.
Weapon damage, taking advantage of Kudzu removing the movement penalty while shooting.

25.resumo: Weakens enemies with Alchemical Flask, pins anyone who doesn't move away from Binding Word and heals inside the fight with Last Stand.

builds.descricao: Resistances and barrier. Last Stand in the middle of the enemy team.
Weapon damage to chase and finish targets pinned by Binding Word.

27.resumo: Hooks to the target with Flying Slash, lands charged strikes with Power Slash and has a transformation that makes her immune to death for a few seconds.

builds.descricao: Spirit power so the charged strike wipes out targets in one go.
Survivability and cooldowns to get the most out of the ultimate.

31.resumo: Pulls himself through the air with Grapple, drops on the target with Ground Strike and lifts the whole team with Death Slam.

builds.descricao: Damage on Ground Strike: the bigger the fall, the bigger the damage.
Resistances to go in first and connect Death Slam on several targets.

35.resumo: Rolls across the map as Goo Ball stunning whoever he hits and protects himself or allies inside The Cube.

builds.descricao: Resistances to roll through the enemy team and get out alive.
Spirit power on the punch and Splatter: lots of damage from range.

50.resumo: Slips into the enemy backline with Flying Cloak, pours out Barrage and escapes into the suitcase with Enchanter's Satchel.

builds.descricao: Spirit power so the rain of projectiles blows up groups.
Close-range weapon damage, using the suitcase to escape.

52.resumo: Chases targets by spinning as Dust Devil, drains health with Fire Scarabs and teleports anywhere on the map with Traveler.

builds.descricao: Weapon damage and fire rate to stack marks and blow the target up.
Survivability and cooldowns to show up in every fight with Traveler.

58.resumo: Slithers behind the enemy team, petrifies targets with Petrifying Bola and finishes with Lethal Venom and gunfire.

builds.descricao: Fire rate and weapon damage against petrified targets.
Spirit power on the daggers and Lethal Venom.

60.resumo: Turns enemies into rabbits with Rabbit Hex and copies an enemy's ultimate with Audience Participation.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on Vexing Bolt and the copied ultimate.
Weapon damage, which the Spectral Assistant repeats with every shot.

63.resumo: Pokes with shots that stack Love Bites, flees as bats with Sanguine Retreat and silences with Nox Nostra.

builds.descricao: Fire rate to trigger Love Bites all the time.
Spirit power on the bite and the cloud of bats.

64.resumo: Tracks enemies with Bloodscent, marks with Stalker's Mark and blinds the enemy team with Eternal Night to hunt isolated targets.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on Rend and the mark's bleed.
Melee to take advantage of Rend's close-range bonus.

65.resumo: Shotgun and crossbow: slams enemies into walls with Gutshot and executes targets with the blessed crossbow of Ira Domini.

builds.descricao: Raw weapon damage for the ultimate's three stakes.
Strong Snap Trap and grenade to control the area.

66.resumo: Gets stronger by taking hits: charges Pain Battery with the damage he receives and comes back from death with Shocking Reanimation.

builds.descricao: Health and regeneration. Aura of Suffering hurts everyone around while you endure.
Spirit power so Pain Battery unloads huge damage.

67.resumo: Gives allies a barrier and extra damage with Plot Armor and heals the whole team across the map with Rallying Charge.

builds.descricao: Healing and cooldowns. Constant barriers on the carry.
Spirit power on Bookwyrm and Captivating Read.

69.resumo: Creates linked portals with Doorway, drags enemies with Luggage Cart and removes a target from the fight with Hotel Guest.

builds.descricao: Cooldowns and utility. Portals to rotate the team.
Spirit power on Call Bell and Luggage Cart.

72.resumo: Charges headfirst with Rising Ram, hammers the ground with Bashdown and chains enemies with Chain Gang.

builds.descricao: Melee: Blasted refills ammo with every hit.
Resistances for Chain Gang in the middle of the enemy team.

76.resumo: Collects deaths in the Jar of Dead to summon the undead and controls corridors with Grasping Hands.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on the summons and the hands. Dominates the area.
Weapon with Essence Theft stealing damage and resistance from the target.

77.resumo: Fences with thrusts in any direction, parries with Riposte and lands a final strike that leaves the target in slow motion.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on Flawless Advance and the ultimate.
Survivability and cooldowns to use Riposte in every trade.

78.resumo: Flies with a jetpack, scatters missiles with Strix Salvo and grabs an enemy to fly up and crash down with them in Close The Deal.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on Strix Salvo and the fuel explosion.
Weapon damage on Jettison Fuel, which reduces bullet resistance.

79.resumo: Hops onto allies to take a nap with Tag Along, healing both of you, and sends Lil Helpers to lend a hand around the map.

builds.descricao: Healing and regeneration. Sticks to the team's carry.
Cooldowns and spirit power for Pillow Toss and Naptime.

80.resumo: Builds bloodlust by dealing damage, transforms automatically with Lycan Curse and pins targets with Entangling Bola.

builds.descricao: Weapon damage and fire rate for Slam Fire.
Health and lifesteal to fight transformed for longer.

81.resumo: Blasts enemies with light, gains spirit lifesteal with Light Eater and silences whoever breaks her barrier.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on Radiant Daggers and Shining Wonder.
Barrier and spirit lifesteal for long fights.

84.resumo: Wears scrap armor that reflects bullets, unleashes rat swarms and raises the banner of Ratannia to empower the team.

builds.descricao: Max health for a bigger barrier on Royal Pestments.
Spirit power on Rat Swarm, which shreds bullet resistance.

85.resumo: Places chess pieces on the map: a patrolling bishop, rooks that immobilize and a knight that protects allies.

builds.descricao: Spirit power on the bishop and Rook Battery.
Kingside Knight barriers for allies and himself.

87.resumo: Heals allies by shooting with Healing Needles, puts leeches on enemies and terrifies anyone who looks at her.

builds.descricao: Cooldowns and healing: needles for whoever needs them.
Spirit power on Leech Therapy and Lurking Terrors.

86.resumo: Paints the battlefield: Flow State's brush slows enemies and speeds up allies, Still Life stuns whoever she draws and Abstract Landscape traps the enemy team in a field of ink.

builds.descricao: Spirit power and duration to complete drawings with Still Life and get stronger with every sketch collected.
Cooldowns and survivability to control fights with Abstract Landscape and give the team mobility with Flow State.

88.resumo: Steals spirit from enemies with Threadsap, walks on the bench's long legs, throws teas that cycle between barrier, silence and burn, and turns enemies into pigeons with Feed The Birds.

builds.descricao: Threadsap steals spirit and every shot gains extra spirit damage. Fire rate and weapon damage take advantage of the theft.
Spirit power and cooldowns on Baba's Brew and Feed The Birds: protects allies and turns the enemy team into pigeons.
Melee build: resistances and heavy-hit items to kick and stomp with Granny Long Legs while Threadsap steals the enemy's spirit.
